title: Critical UI Fix: Restore Button Visibility (White-on-White Bug)

requirements.summary: Force all primary action buttons across the entire app to use solid #0056b3 background with bold white text, overriding any conflicting Tailwind or CSS custom properties
acceptanceCriteria: All primary action buttons display a solid #0056b3 blue background.
All button labels are clearly legible with white text.
No button is invisible or blends into a white/light background.
Fix applies consistently across HomePage, CheckoutPage, OrderConfirmationPage, MobileRechargeSection, ProductCard, CartDrawer, and all other pages with buttons.

file_operations.description: Override the 'default' button variant to use bg-[#0056b3] text-white font-bold, ensuring all primary buttons render with the correct colors. Add !important-style inline overrides if necessary to defeat any CSS variable conflicts.
Ensure the 'Place Order' button uses the fixed button variant with explicit bg-[#0056b3] text-white font-bold classes, making it clearly visible and clickable.
Ensure the 'Place Recharge Order' button in the dialog uses bg-[#0056b3] text-white font-bold, making it clearly visible and clickable.
Ensure the 'Add to Cart' button uses bg-[#0056b3] text-white font-bold, making it clearly visible against the product card background.
Ensure the 'Checkout' button uses bg-[#0056b3] text-white font-bold, making it clearly visible in the cart drawer.
Ensure any CTA buttons (e.g., 'Continue Shopping' or payment confirmation actions) use bg-[#0056b3] text-white font-bold.

requirements.summary: Fix Header component so 'Logout' and 'Cart' buttons are clearly visible with sufficient color contrast
acceptanceCriteria: 'Logout' button in Header is visible and has readable text.
'Cart' icon button in Header is visible with its item count badge clearly displayed.
Both buttons pass basic contrast requirements against the header background.

file_operations.description: Ensure the 'Logout' button uses bg-[#0056b3] text-white font-bold. Ensure the 'Cart' icon button (ShoppingCart icon and badge) has a visible stroke/fill color (e.g., text-gray-800 or text-[#0056b3]) and the badge has a contrasting background (e.g., bg-red-500 text-white) so it stands out against the header background.

requirements.summary: Restore Sign-In page so the login button is NOT white and is clearly clickable with #0056b3 background and white text
acceptanceCriteria: Sign-In page renders with a clearly visible login button in #0056b3 with white text.
The button is not white, transparent, or blended into the background.
User can identify and click the Sign-In button without any confusion.

file_operations.description: Ensure the 'Login' button (rendered when user is not authenticated) uses bg-[#0056b3] text-white font-bold, making it clearly visible and clickable on the sign-in/home page.

requirements.summary: Fix CategoryFilter component so category buttons are visible with legible labels, using #0056b3 for active and light gray for inactive
acceptanceCriteria: All category filter buttons are visible with readable labels.
Active/selected category button is highlighted in #0056b3 with white text.
Unselected category buttons use a clearly visible style distinct from the page background.

file_operations.description: Ensure active category buttons use bg-[#0056b3] text-white font-bold. Ensure inactive buttons use bg-gray-200 text-gray-800 or similar to remain visible and distinct from the page background.

requirements.summary: Audit and fix global CSS custom properties and Tailwind theme to ensure --primary resolves to #0056b3 and --primary-foreground to #ffffff in light theme
acceptanceCriteria: CSS custom property --primary resolves to #0056b3 (or equivalent) in light theme.
No button component inherits a white-on-white style from the theme tokens.
Dark mode tokens, if defined, also maintain readable button contrast.

file_operations.description: Update the :root CSS custom properties to set --primary to the OKLCH equivalent of #0056b3 and --primary-foreground to the OKLCH equivalent of #ffffff. Verify that no --background, --card, or other token resolves to white/near-white in a way that causes buttons to become invisible.

Ensure the Tailwind theme extends colors.primary to reference var(--primary) and colors.primary-foreground to reference var(--primary-foreground). Confirm that the default button variant in the design system will pick up these corrected values.
